LOTUS BAY ESTATE | 56.1 ACRES OF LAKE ERIE FRONTAGE

An extraordinary opportunity to own one of Western New York’s most remarkable Lake Erie properties. Introducing Lotus Bay Estate, a rare 56.1 acre offering featuring approximately 765 linear feet of Lake Erie frontage, dramatic natural bluffs, sandy beach, and breathtaking waterfront views.

This expansive property offers the unique opportunity to create a private lakefront estate unlike anything else in the area, with an abundance of land, privacy, and direct access to the beauty of Lake Erie. The shoreline itself offers a distinctive combination of elevated bluff frontage and sandy beach, creating multiple opportunities to enjoy the waterfront and its ever changing sunsets.

Approximately 11+ acres are located on the opposite side of Lake Shore Road, adding significant acreage and flexibility to the property. The expansive landholding also presents potential for future subdivision and development, offering an attractive opportunity for investors, developers, or those looking to create a private lakefront community, subject to municipal approvals, zoning, and applicable regulations.

Whether envisioned as a spectacular private retreat, generational family compound, or thoughtfully planned lakefront development, Lotus Bay Estate represents a truly rare opportunity to acquire substantial Lake Erie frontage and acreage in one offering.

Can be sold together with multi-family property listing MLS - B1709418, APN: 142889-265-040-0001-050-100
